system:
Each line below is a question that one person's writing takes a position on, written by someone reading their excerpts in batches, so the same issue appears in many wordings.

Group the questions by the issue they bear on: the broader point on which a person could hold one view and later change their mind, such as "the nature of the mind" or "whether art redeems life". Put two questions in one group when an answer to one would commit the writer to a view on the other, or when they are two angles on the same issue, even if their words differ. Keep apart questions that only share a word. Aim for groups of 3 to 15 questions; a question that bears on no other stays alone.

Reply with JSON only: {"groups":[{"name":"the issue","members":["Q1","Q7"]}]}. Every question appears in exactly one group.
